citation: Hiratsu A, et al. J Exerc Sci Fit 2022;20:140
protocol: 10-h overnight fast; cycle ergometer 60 min at 75% of heart-rate reserve followed by a 15-min performance test; blood at -60 (before drink), 0, 60, 105, 165 min; placebo (dextrin 5.5 g) arm of the acute arginine trial (the 14-day chronic arm is separate)
population: 16 healthy young men, 23 +/- 3 y, BMI 23.0 +/- 1.5, VO2max 53.3 +/- 11.0 mL/kg/min
note: Placebo is a carbohydrate (dextrin) taken before exercise; acute and chronic rows sit side by side, read only Acute-Placebo; five times including 2 h recovery.
